Preliminary · 17 Sep 2026 · median + seed points

Kimonu Benchmark Figures

Five draft figures drawn from one verified data file. Stochastic arms show the median over seeds with each seed drawn as a point (n = 3); exact arms have no spread by construction. Starred arms exist for comparability, not as recommendations. Every reference number here predates the final rerun on the fixed LP bridge.

Kimonu 33 · COCOA efficient=false 30 (all at 3 seeds) · efficient=true 14 · reference exhaustive 9 (R stage on 6) · reference sampled 9

F1

Balanced complexes

ready

Exact agreement with the reference on all nine models. All arms present; reference values predate the bridge fix but this stage uses no pair LP.

F2

Concordance modules

reference pre-rerun

Kimonu vs COCOA across 33 is ready. The reference bars are hatched: their concordance predates both the bridge fix and the three algorithm fixes and is sound on 6 of 9 only by adjudication. They will be replaced by the final rerun.

F3

Largest kinetic module

ready · reference on 6

Two Kimonu bars: the Upstream Algorithm (Remark S2-1) and, starred, the tentative four-phase version reproducing the reference's algorithm. Giants agree on 25 of 33; the reference's own R-stage giants (corrected NA subscript) on 6 models. COCOA efficient=false overshoots on iJN678 (1183 vs 551) in every seed, and on iIT341 / iHN637 in one seed of three.

F4

ACR and ACRR (free)

ready · reference on 6

Every reference ACRR pair is in Kimonu's set by name on all six models; the reference's criterion is the combinatorial sufficient condition, Kimonu's is the kernel test. The tall COCOA efficient=false bars on iIT341 and iHN637 come from a single seed whose concordance cascaded (ACRR 2089 and 2211 against 20–24 and 116 in the other two seeds); iJN678's 2484 is stable across seeds.

F5

Runtime

ready

Reference times are concordance only and from the pre-fix bridge; the fixed bridge adds cold re-solves and will be somewhat slower. Right panel: Kimonu's kinetic stage dominates on every model because its exact concordance is nearly free — the inverse of the reference, which spends ≈100% in concordance.

Source: benchmarks/figdata.json, drawn by benchmarks/figures/make_prelim.py. Provenance and trust per arm: the Pipeline Ledger.
